sup:70530.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – counter-proposal for part:350020
move.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your offer. Our forecast fc:350020@2026-09 confirms a steady 4580 pcs per year, and we are prepared to commit for 24 months.

Under our current agreement ctr:4600070530 the payment term is 90 days, so a reduction to 30 days is a significant change for us.

Your scorecard sc:70530@2026Q3 shows on-time delivery of 84.6 %, which we would like to see improve during the new term.

Could you share how your cost increases translate into the unit price, and whether a cheaper variant exists? Please consider the attached packages.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Thank you for your counter-proposal and the forecast confirmation. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION. Material accounts for about 42 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our specialists will separately address your inquiries regarding the cost breakdown and alternative technical variants.

We are pleased to accept the 24-month contract duration and the 60-day payment term, for which we can offer a revised unit price of €431.47.

Our Angebot stands at a price of €432.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. As an alternative, we offer a price of €431.47 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – counter-proposal for part:350020
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.
We understand that your price is fixed for now, so we have looked at the terms instead.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Our bottom-up cost model puts the full cost of this part at EUR 403.21 per unit (cost:350020).
Your rolling scorecard shows on-time delivery of 84.6% (sc:70530@2026Q3).
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09).

Please find 2 packages below. Each of them works for us; let us know which one suits you best.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

We have verified your should-cost model data and factored it into our calculation. Please note that the delivery record and volume change data you cited were already accounted for in our previous offer. Material accounts for about 42 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. As to the should cost data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. 

Our current Angebot is a price of €432.55 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months.

In exchange for the 36-month contract term, we can offer a revised unit price of €432.55. Alternatively, with a contract term of 36 months: €432.55 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year.

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer stands at a price of €432.55 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months.

A longer Zahlungsziel costs us interest; that is priced in. Furthermore, the contract term is reflected in the price. Our list price stays as it is, but on the terms we have room - that is where we can meet you. However, without movement from your side we cannot move either.

This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
